name: Urovo Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Urovo Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells automatic identification and data collection terminal products in China and internationally. The company offers payment terminals; mobile computers comprising handheld mobile and wearable computers; RFID devices, such as handheld and fixed RFID readers, RFID sleds, and RFID printers; healthcare devices; rugged tablets; barcode scanners; and mobile and desktop laptop printers, as well as UROVO enterprise enabler, a cross-platform and cross-terminal software and cloud service platform.
